entries.title: Business & industrial advisory
entries.label: A01
entries.description: Define the next step with a clear commercial and operational plan.
entries.intro: We review objectives, stakeholders and operating constraints, then agree a practical roadmap.
entries.problem: Unclear priorities can delay investment and implementation.
entries.response: We review objectives, stakeholders and operating constraints, then agree a practical roadmap.
entries.outcome: A prioritised action plan with responsibilities, assumptions and decision points.

entries.title: Market & opportunity intelligence
entries.label: A02
entries.description: Evidence to understand a market and identify relevant opportunities.
entries.intro: We organise desk research around a defined question and document sources, limitations and commercial context.
entries.problem: Market information is fragmented and opportunities are difficult to compare.
entries.response: We organise desk research around a defined question and document sources, limitations and commercial context.
entries.outcome: A focused research brief and an opportunity shortlist for further due diligence.

entries.title: Supplier & investor readiness
entries.label: A03
entries.description: Prepare your business for procurement and investment conversations.
entries.intro: We assess readiness, identify evidence gaps and support the preparation of business and capability materials.
entries.problem: A capable business may lack the records and presentation needed for assessment.
entries.response: We assess readiness, identify evidence gaps and support the preparation of business and capability materials.
entries.outcome: A readiness checklist and a clearer evidence pack; procurement awards and funding are not guaranteed.

entries.title: Local content & compliance support
entries.label: A04
entries.description: Organise the requirements and evidence relevant to your participation.
entries.intro: We help map applicable official sources, document obligations and organise evidence with your qualified advisers.
entries.problem: Changing requirements and incomplete records can slow supplier participation.
entries.response: We help map applicable official sources, document obligations and organise evidence with your qualified advisers.
entries.outcome: A traceable requirements register and a practical compliance action plan; legal opinions require qualified counsel.

entries.title: Feasibility & research
entries.label: A05
entries.description: Test an idea before committing resources.
entries.intro: We scope research, document assumptions and compare options with proportionate analysis.
entries.problem: An opportunity needs evidence of demand, delivery constraints and commercial viability.
entries.response: We scope research, document assumptions and compare options with proportionate analysis.
entries.outcome: A decision brief identifying options, risks, evidence gaps and recommended next steps.

entries.title: Data & registry services
entries.label: A06
entries.description: Organised information that your team can maintain and use.
entries.intro: We define a data model, clean agreed sources and design controlled collection and update workflows.
entries.problem: Disconnected spreadsheets and inconsistent records make research and coordination harder.
entries.response: We define a data model, clean agreed sources and design controlled collection and update workflows.
entries.outcome: A structured dataset and documented ownership, quality checks and maintenance process.

entries.title: AI & data solutions
entries.description: Turn fragmented information into a usable foundation for analysis and responsible AI.
entries.intro: Useful AI starts with well-understood data and a clearly defined business problem. We help organisations structure information, improve reporting and identify where AI can support practical workflows.
priorities: AI use-case assessment and scoped prototypes
Evaluation, human oversight and data governance
entries.problem: Fragmented data and unclear AI use cases make useful analysis difficult.
entries.outcome: A scoped data and AI plan, with agreed quality checks, evaluation and human oversight.
entries.response: Useful AI starts with well-understood data and a clearly defined business problem. We help organisations structure information, improve reporting and identify where AI can support practical workflows.

entries.title: ERP & Odoo
entries.description: Connected business systems, built around the way your organisation operates.
entries.intro: KINT’s ERP and Odoo work starts with the business process: how information moves, where control is needed and which teams depend on each other. Implementation is planned around scope, data quality and adoption.
priorities: User training and ongoing system support
entries.problem: Separate business tools and inconsistent records create duplicate work and weak visibility.
entries.outcome: An agreed implementation scope, connected workflows and a tested migration and adoption plan.
entries.response: KINT’s ERP and Odoo work starts with the business process: how information moves, where control is needed and which teams depend on each other. Implementation is planned around scope, data quality and adoption.

entries.title: Software & digital platforms
entries.description: Purpose-built software and corporate platforms for real operational needs.
entries.intro: From enterprise websites to internal tools, custom software should fit the work it supports. We plan, design and build maintainable platforms with clear requirements and sensible integration boundaries.
entries.problem: Generic tools and disconnected websites can leave important business needs unmet.
entries.outcome: A maintainable, accessible platform with agreed functionality, integrations and handover documentation.
entries.response: From enterprise websites to internal tools, custom software should fit the work it supports. We plan, design and build maintainable platforms with clear requirements and sensible integration boundaries.

entries.title: Cloud & infrastructure
entries.description: Dependable digital foundations for business systems and teams.
entries.intro: Reliable infrastructure supports everything above it. KINT helps plan and implement cloud and server environments, alongside Microsoft 365 and digital workplace systems that help teams work consistently.
entries.problem: Unclear infrastructure ownership and recovery arrangements put business continuity at risk.
entries.outcome: A documented environment with agreed access, recovery, monitoring and support arrangements.
entries.response: Reliable infrastructure supports everything above it. KINT helps plan and implement cloud and server environments, alongside Microsoft 365 and digital workplace systems that help teams work consistently.

entries.title: Automation & reporting
entries.description: Reduce manual handoffs. Make operational information easier to use.
entries.intro: Repeated manual tasks can hide errors and slow down decisions. We examine the workflow first, then connect systems and design reporting that makes responsibilities, exceptions and outcomes visible.
entries.problem: Manual handoffs and inconsistent reporting delay action and increase errors.
entries.outcome: Connected workflows and decision-relevant reporting with clear ownership and exception handling.
entries.response: Repeated manual tasks can hide errors and slow down decisions. We examine the workflow first, then connect systems and design reporting that makes responsibilities, exceptions and outcomes visible.

entries.title: Cybersecurity & data governance
entries.description: Build better control over access, information and digital risk.
entries.intro: Security and information governance belong in the design of business systems. KINT’s approach focuses on practical access controls, information handling and documented responsibilities within implementation engagements.
entries.problem: Inconsistent access and information handling expose avoidable operational risks.
entries.outcome: Documented access and handling controls, with responsibilities and recovery requirements agreed for the engagement.
entries.response: Security and information governance belong in the design of business systems. KINT’s approach focuses on practical access controls, information handling and documented responsibilities within implementation engagements.

entries.title: Industrial intelligence
entries.label: 07 / In development
entries.description: A developing product direction for connected industrial information.
entries.intro: KINT Intelligence is our longer-term development programme. We are exploring how structured industrial datasets, knowledge relationships and AI-assisted research can make company, project and market information easier to understand. These products are not yet commercially available.
priorities: Search, knowledge graphs and AI-assisted analysis
